name: copilot-usage-monitor
description: Monitor your GitHub Copilot usage in the status bar as a percentage: your plan's own quota, or your organization's shared AI-credit pool once an owner connects it

commands.title: Copilot Usage: Sign in to GitHub

copilotUsage.organization.description: The login of a GitHub organization whose shared Copilot AI-credit pool to show. Set it with 'Copilot Usage: Connect Organization', which connects token-free when GitHub allows it, and otherwise stores a read-only token in VS Code secret storage. Leave empty to show your own plan only. Application-scoped: a workspace cannot set it.

copilotUsage.writeUsageState.description: Write the Copilot usage percentage to ~/.nexus-hub/state/usage-probe/copilot.json so the Nexus-Hub usage-guard hook can read it. The file holds percentages, reset times, and the figure's source only: no login, organization name, or token.

copilotUsage.autoFetch.description: Automatically fetch Copilot usage from GitHub on startup and at regular intervals

copilotUsage.refreshInterval.description: How often (in minutes) to fetch usage data from GitHub

copilotUsage.showInStatusBar.description: Show Copilot usage in the status bar

copilotUsage.compactStatusBar.description: Use a compact status-bar label: '<icon> X% (pool)' instead of '<icon> Copilot Usage: X% (pool)'.

copilotUsage.thresholds.moderate.description: Usage percentage at which the Moderate urgency level is triggered

copilotUsage.thresholds.high.description: Usage percentage at which the High urgency level is triggered

copilotUsage.thresholds.critical.description: Usage percentage at which the Critical urgency level is triggered

copilotUsage.notificationTimeoutSeconds.description: How long (in seconds) Copilot Usage notifications stay on screen before auto-dismissing. Set this so notifications never stack while VS Code is in the background. Manual dismiss via the X button is always available.

copilotUsage.colors.moderate.description: Status bar background color when usage is at the Moderate level. Use a hex color (e.g. #cca700) or 'none' to disable highlighting.

copilotUsage.colors.high.description: Status bar background color when usage is at the High level. Use a hex color (e.g. #f0643c) or 'none' to disable highlighting.

copilotUsage.colors.critical.description: Status bar background color when usage is at the Critical level. Use a hex color (e.g. #e05555) or 'none' to disable highlighting.
